hot_themes: Social awkwardness and high-stakes peer interactions
Psychological tricks for handling bullies or critics
The dark side of turning passions into work
hook_patterns: Exposing corporate or workplace secrets people secretly suspect
Calling out hyper-relatable flaws like overthinking or people-pleasing
ideas_for_us: The Overjustification Effect: One friend explains why monetizing their favorite video game ruined it forever, animated through dramatic overreactions.
The Spotlight Effect: One friend wears an absurd outfit in public, convincing themselves everyone is staring, while the other breaks down the cognitive bias.
The Scarcity Heuristic: The friends create a fake absurdly limited-edition rock to demonstrate why people buy useless junk they don't need.
The Pratfall Effect: One friend accidentally trips in front of their crush, and the second friend explains why being clumsy actually made them more likable.
